jobs.titleZh: 高级研发工程师——StarRC 寄生参数提取
jobs.titleEn: Senior R&D Engineer — StarRC Parasitic Extraction
responsibilitiesZh: 为 StarRC 研究、设计并实现面向 FinFET、GAA 及 3nm、2nm 以下节点的晶体管级寄生参数提取能力
使用模式匹配与场求解方法开发互连电容、电感和电阻模型
以 C++ 设计能够处理超大版图数据的算法与数据结构，并平衡提取精度、容量和运行时间
与版图、仿真、时序、物理验证、晶圆厂及客户团队协作解决先进工艺、3D IC 与先进封装提取问题
responsibilitiesEn: Researches, designs, and implements transistor-level StarRC extraction capabilities for FinFET, GAA, and process nodes at 3 nm, 2 nm, and beyond
Develops interconnect capacitance, inductance, and resistance models using pattern matching and field-solver methods
Designs C++ algorithms and data structures for massive layout datasets while balancing extraction accuracy, capacity, and runtime
Works with layout, simulation, timing, physical-verification, foundry, and customer teams on advanced-node, 3D IC, and advanced-packaging extraction
minimumQualificationsZh: 电气工程、计算机科学或计算机工程硕士或博士，并具有至少一年相关 EDA 软件开发经验
熟练掌握 C++、算法设计及面向大规模软件系统的数据结构
具备计算电磁学背景，包括全波或准静态电磁建模、Maxwell 方程，以及 FEM、BEM 或 MoM 等数值方法
理解寄生效应对电路性能和签核的影响；LVS、提取、场求解器或电路仿真流程经验为加分项
minimumQualificationsEn: MS or PhD in electrical engineering, computer science, or computer engineering with at least one year of relevant EDA software-development experience
Proficiency in C++, algorithm design, and data structures for large-scale software systems
Background in computational electromagnetics, including full-wave or quasi-static modeling, Maxwell’s equations, and numerical methods such as FEM, BEM, or MoM
Understanding of parasitic impact on circuit performance and signoff; LVS, extraction, field-solver, or circuit-simulation experience is a plus
eligibilityZh: 官方岗位页未披露签证赞助、CPT 接受条件或出口管制限制，须由招聘方按该岗位确认
该岗位要求研究生学历和至少一年相关 EDA 经验，不是入门级实习岗位
eligibilityEn: The official posting does not disclose sponsorship, CPT acceptance, or export-control restrictions; recruiting must confirm them for this requisition
The role requires a graduate degree and at least one year of relevant EDA experience and is not an entry-level internship

compensation.notesZh: 雇主披露美国基本工资区间为 116,000–174,000 美元；奖金、股权及其他酌情奖励另计，最终报价取决于地点、技能、经验和教育背景
compensation.notesEn: The employer discloses a U.S. base-salary range of $116,000–$174,000; annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary awards may be additional, and the final offer depends on location, skills, experience, and education

jobs.titleZh: 应用工程科学家——Agentic AI EDA
jobs.titleEn: Applications Engineering Scientist — Agentic AI EDA
responsibilitiesZh: 定义 Fusion Compiler 中 Agentic AI 的体系结构愿景及自主代理与核心实现引擎之间的接口
构建能够在十亿门级设计空间中规划策略、分配资源并从失败路径恢复的多智能体系统
设计代理推理与规划层，把时序收敛、拥塞缓解和功耗优化等复杂目标分解为可自适应的子目标
把代理系统与综合、布局、CTS、布线及优化引擎集成，并推动可解释、可控制的人机协同
responsibilitiesEn: Defines the architectural vision for agentic AI in Fusion Compiler and the interfaces between autonomous agents and core implementation engines
Architects multi-agent systems that navigate billion-gate design spaces, set strategies, allocate resources, and recover from dead ends
Designs reasoning and planning layers that decompose timing closure, congestion mitigation, and power optimization into adaptive sub-goals
Integrates agents with synthesis, placement, CTS, routing, and optimization engines while advancing transparent and controllable human-agent collaboration
minimumQualificationsZh: 在 EDA、VLSI CAD、芯片设计或相邻领域具有十五年以上经验，并在逻辑综合、物理设计、STA 或优化算法至少一项具备深厚专长
有定义并交付生产级体系结构解决方案的领导经验，能够区分研究原型和规模化生产系统
掌握 LLM Agent、强化学习、搜索与规划及 RAG 等 AI/ML 方法
深入理解时序图、布局合法化、布线拥塞、时钟树权衡和电源完整性等数字实现问题
minimumQualificationsEn: Fifteen or more years in EDA, VLSI CAD, chip design, or an adjacent field, with deep expertise in logic synthesis, physical design, static timing analysis, or optimization algorithms
Leadership experience defining and shipping production-scale architectural solutions and distinguishing prototypes from production systems
Strong AI/ML foundation spanning LLM agents, reinforcement learning, search and planning, and retrieval-augmented generation
Deep understanding of timing graphs, placement legality, routing congestion, clock-tree trade-offs, and power-grid integrity
eligibilityZh: 官方岗位页未披露签证赞助、CPT 接受条件或出口管制限制，须由招聘方按该岗位确认
十五年以上经验门槛意味着该职位属于资深科学家/架构师岗位，不适合作为当前学生直接申请目标，但可作为长期能力标尺
eligibilityEn: The official posting does not disclose sponsorship, CPT acceptance, or export-control restrictions; recruiting must confirm them for this requisition
The fifteen-plus-year requirement makes this a senior scientist or architect role rather than a direct student target, but it remains a useful long-term capability benchmark

compensation.notesZh: 雇主披露美国基本工资区间为 196,000–294,000 美元；奖金、股权及其他酌情奖励另计，最终报价取决于地点、技能、经验和教育背景
compensation.notesEn: The employer discloses a U.S. base-salary range of $196,000–$294,000; annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary awards may be additional, and the final offer depends on location, skills, experience, and education

jobs.originalTitle: [Summer 2027] TSMC AZ Internship Opportunities - Engineering Roles
responsibilitiesZh: 覆盖制程整合、良率、制程、设备、智能制造、AMHS、质量、产品、光罩、工具安装、安全与 CIM 等多个实习方向
在先进晶圆厂环境中使用数据分析、系统化排障、自动化、监控或机器学习方法改进生产
以跨团队协作为基础完成十周全职现场项目并汇报成果
responsibilitiesEn: Covers internship tracks in process integration, yield, process, equipment, intelligent manufacturing, AMHS, quality, product, mask, tool install, safety, and CIM
Uses data analysis, systematic troubleshooting, automation, observability, or machine learning to improve advanced-fab operations
Completes a ten-week full-time on-site project with cross-functional collaboration and presentation
minimumQualificationsZh: 就读于受认可大学的相关本科、硕士或博士项目
能够在 2027 年指定日期于 Phoenix 现场全职工作十周
具备主动学习、协作、沟通、计算机与展示能力
minimumQualificationsEn: Currently enrolled in a relevant bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD program at an accredited university
Able to work full-time on site in Phoenix for ten weeks during one of the specified Summer 2027 windows
Demonstrates self-directed learning, collaboration, communication, computing, and presentation skills
eligibilityZh: 申请人必须在美国具有合法工作资格
岗位可能接触出口管制技术数据，非美国人士可能需要出口许可
是否可由 F-1 CPT 满足要求必须在申请前向招聘方逐岗确认
eligibilityEn: Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States
Roles may involve export-controlled technical data, and non-U.S. persons may require an export license
Whether F-1 CPT satisfies the requirement must be confirmed with recruiting for the exact track before applying

responsibilitiesZh: 设计、制造并表征超导量子比特及相关器件

在稀释制冷机等低温测试环境中开发量子比特控制与测量硬件
responsibilitiesEn: Designs, builds, and characterizes superconducting qubits and related devices
Develops fabrication processes that improve qubit coherence and reproducibility
Builds qubit-control and measurement hardware in cryogenic environments including dilution refrigerators

三年以上量子硬件或相近研发环境经验
具备超导量子比特、低温测量、器件制造或相关量子技术经验
能够在 Madison 现场工作
minimumQualificationsEn: BS, MS, or PhD in physics, electrical engineering, or a related field
Three or more years of experience in quantum hardware or a similar R&D environment
Experience with superconducting qubits, cryogenic measurement, device fabrication, or related quantum technologies
Able to work on site in Madison
